summary: The rendered output captures several key text fields correctly, but it has major fidelity problems in the date conversion, the upper form-field structure, and the representation of stamps/signatures/seals. The source’s BS registration date is not converted to Gregorian, the PAN and office fields are collapsed rather than reproduced as structured fields, and several visual placeholders are mislabeled or missing.
matches_well: The main document title is translated correctly as a Permanent Account Number (PAN) Registration Certificate.
The issuing authority header content is broadly present: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue Department.
The taxpayer name is correctly rendered as “Shree Future Stars English Boarding School Katari”.
The legal form “Private Limited” is present.
The address is correctly rendered as Ward No. 8, Katari Municipality, Katari, Udayapur.
The business type is correctly translated as “Secondary schools”.
The left-side Government of Nepal emblem is represented by a placeholder box, which is acceptable for digitization.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows the Bikram Sambat registration/issue date as Year 2069, Month 03, Day 13. In the English digitization this should be converted to the corresponding Gregorian date, not left as a BS date or reordered as day/month/year.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The date is shown as “13/03/2069” with “Day Month Year”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source has a clear form layout: a boxed Permanent Account Number row in the center, separate left-side fields for Inland Revenue Office, VAT, Taxpayer Service Office, and Excise, and a separate registration-date grid on the right.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The PAN, Inland Revenue Office, Taxpayer Service Office, VAT, and Excise Duty labels are collapsed into a very small crowded inline row. The prominent boxed PAN digit row is not reproduced as a separate field.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows a blue school/organization stamp impression with handwriting/signature in this area, not a simple school logo.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: A placeholder box is labeled “Future Stars English School logo”.

discrepancies.location: signature and seal area near middle of page
discrepancies.source_observation: The source has handwritten signatures and stamp/seal impressions on both the taxpayer side and the tax officer side, including a visible round seal near the tax officer signature. These are not fully represented with appropriate placeholders.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The taxpayer side is represented by one large box labeled “School stamp” with “Taxpayer’s Signature” inside, while the tax officer side is only plain text reading “Tax Officer’s Signature”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source presents the taxpayer duties as a heading followed by multiple numbered/bulleted lines, preserving clearer list structure.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The duties section is rendered as a single very small paragraph.
